tagline: Lightweight open-source Minecraft launcher with isolated instances, Modrinth and CurseForge support
description: Prism Launcher is a popular free, open-source (GPL-3.0) Minecraft launcher focused on clean instance management, direct modpack/mod installation from Modrinth and CurseForge, and flexible Java configuration across Windows, macOS, and Linux.
features: Built-in Modrinth & CurseForge mod, shader, and resource pack manager
Isolated game instances and automatic Java runtime management
